timing.note: main loop is paced by CIA1 timer A (latch $276A, IRQ decrements $B479); 3 timer IRQs per game tick. 'ticks' below = main-loop iterations ($19). 'irq_frames' = 50.125 Hz raster IRQ frames ($1A). Measured in harness: 103 ticks per 159 video frames.

start.note: $9403 set to 4 then decremented once at game start (display 3). Game over when a ship is lost while the display shows 0.

score_storage: 3 BCD bytes $0180(lo)..$0182 holding score/10; a fixed '0' digit is part of the status-bar graphic

scores.planet_destroyed_bonus: 2000 (= 400*5, only if pod was brought out while countdown running)

object_types.0: limpet gun, sprite shape $22, bullet spawn offset (+4,+0)

limpet_gun.A3_formula: mission 1-2: 1; mission n>=3: min(35, n-1); +8 on the mission after a 'planet destroyed without pod' failure; demo: 2
conditions: 0 <= gun_y - scroll_y < 256 (high bytes equal) -- no x test
limpet_gun.direction: (base + (rand_hi & mask) + (rand8() & 3)) & 31; base = flags & $1C, mask = [1,3,7,15][flags & 3]; dir 0 = up, clockwise, 32 steps
limpet_gun.bullet_velocity_table: dir -> (vx, vy) in 1/256 units per tick, see direction_table
limpet_gun.max_bullets: shared pool of 32 slots ($0600-$07BF) with explosions/smoke/stars; player uses slots 0-3

player_bullets.velocity: direction_table[ship_angle] + ship velocity; pre-advanced 2 steps at spawn

reactor.damage_accumulator: $3E, reset to 0 on every (re)spawn of the ship (A5B9 clears zero page)
reactor.on_hit: $3E += rand8()&31 (+carry); recharge $3D = $3E; if 8-bit overflow and no countdown: critical
reactor.recharge: $3D decremented every 2nd tick -> guns silent (and no smoke) for 2*$3E ticks after a hit
reactor.hits_to_critical: sum of rand(0..31) must exceed 255 -> typically 14-20 hits (measured 17)

countdown.display: digit drawn at status chars row1 col13 and col25

reactor.blink: while counting, reactor drawn only when ($69 & 4) == 0 (4 ticks on / 4 off)
reactor.smoke: every 8 ticks if $3D==0 and no countdown: particle at (x+4,y), vy=-114/256/tick, life 10, owner 1 (harmless)
reactor.at_zero: ship killed, every alive object (except pod) explodes, background colour flash ($02=15, table $8B31), landscape hidden afterwards

fuel.beam_window: 1 <= cell_x - ship_x($33) <= 5 and 0 <= cell_y - ship_y($2F/30) < 28, ship alive, no pod attached, SPACE held
fuel.thrust_cost: 1 per thrust tick, thrust applied on 6 of 16 ticks ($19&15 in {0,3,5,8,11,13}) -> 0.375/tick
fuel.empty: $9402=$FF: thrust/shield disabled; next ship loss or planet exit = GAME OVER (lives ignored), text 'Out of fuel'

doors.trigger: player bullet hits switch type 7 or 8 -> $6B = 255 (re-shoot re-arms); $6B -= 1 per tick
doors.open_amount: $6C: if $6B < max then $6C = $6B else $6C = min(max, $6C+1)  (opens 1/tick, held, closes 1/tick)

4.kind: plug: row (index==open) edge $98 else $A6 (opens row by row)

levels.cycle: after each 6 planets $A6A5 toggles (reverse gravity); when it toggles back to 0, $A5 toggles (invisible landscape)
levels.reverse_gravity: gravity byte $A7 = gravity XOR $FF, sign $A6 = $FF; ship angle starts at 16 (pointing down)
levels.invisible: landscape drawn only while shield/tractor held or ship exploding (screen $5400 vs $5C00 colour map)

leave_planet.condition: ship y ($0B/$0C) in [$0100,$0120) and ship not exploding

outcomes.pod attached: 'Mission N Complete' [+ 'Planet Destroyed'] 'Bonus X' -> next planet
outcomes.no pod, countdown never started: 'Mission Incomplete' 1.2 s -> same planet again (no life lost, mission number unchanged)
outcomes.no pod, countdown running: 'Planet Destroyed' 'Mission N Failed' 'No Bonus' 2.4 s -> next planet, $A3 +8

death_outcomes.countdown active: 'Planet Destroyed / Mission N Failed / No Bonus', next planet (life lost)
death_outcomes.otherwise: same planet restarts at last restart point (life lost)

highscores.entry: 16 bytes at $0100+16*i: 3 BCD score/10 (lo first), 13 chars name (3 spaces + 10 name chars)
highscores.name_input: max 10 chars, RETURN ends, DEL deletes, $20-$7E accepted

title.demo: level 1 with scripted input $B4FC/$B50E (some durations randomised), ends on death/exit or SPACE

random: 16-bit state s=($3B<<8|$3A): t=((s<<2)|1)&$FFFF; s=(s+t)&$FFFF; hi=(hi+old_lo)&$FF; return hi^lo
